span.p:
colKindString
try tagColStrDict first
(distinct table + index;
dict wins vs the n-byte per-value floor,
so skewed low-card columns dict-code too)
flat index → 0xF5, QPack index → 0xFC,
front-coded table → 0xFA (prefix-shared);
otherwise per-value + intern

colKindTime
SPLIT into TWO sub-columns:
sec → []int64 (Delta+FOR, monotonic timestamps → near-zero bytes)
nsec → []uint64 (QPack)

colKindNullable (high bit 0x80)
presence bitmap: 1 bit/row, LSB-first
dense column of present values only
→ base colKind codec applied
(no per-row alloc for absent rows)
